The test image shows a classic diagnostic cut of a tomato stem revealing internal vascular/pith browning. The longitudinal split revealing extensive brown internal tissue while the outer cortex is green is most characteristic of **Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt_Of_Tomato** (Clavibacter michiganensis subsp. michiganensis), which classically shows internal pith browning and a Bugwood image (13) showed a similar stem-cutting diagnostic approach with internal discoloration. The pattern of the entire pith being brown/necrotic with green outer cortex matches bacterial canker's characteristic internal symptom.
